data: Which of the following have a log(Valid. Perplexity) value more than 100 at epoch 0?

The question asks which of the following have a log(Valid. Perplexity) value more than 100 at epoch 0. From the caption, we know that the figure shows the initial softmax perplexity for different learning rates. The x-axis represents the epoch number, and the y-axis represents the log(Valid. Perplexity). 

Looking at the left graph (a), we can see three lines representing Softmax(LR=1), Softmax(LR=2), and Softmax(LR=3). At epoch 0, the y-axis values for all three lines are above 100. Therefore, the log(Valid. Perplexity) values for all three lines are more than 100 at epoch 0.

Thus, the answer is: Softmax(LR=1), Softmax(LR=2), and Softmax(LR=3).
